answer: Each published orchard may issue only a fixed timber allotment per epoch, and a cultivator may countersign just one applicant. The signature is valid only after the applicant finishes a live task scored at zenith and bound to their address plus the epoch seed. Settlement draws a bipartite graph of cultivators and applicants; dense shared-cultivator cliques, reused zenith-task transcripts, or over-cut timber lots are burned, and those cultivators forfeit the next two allotments.
